entities.summary: Slavko Brezoski was a Macedonian architect, urban planner, painter, writer and educator known for his works in the genre of modern architecture realised during the middle of the 20th century in modern-day North Macedonia, Serbia, Croatia, Brazil and Libya. He was a professor and Dean at the Faculty of Architecture at the Ss. Cyril and Methodius University of Skopje.
